text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Our sauna endurance showdown
yesterday was so
intense!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was confident in my skills, but I
never
anticipated such a long battle.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
We gotta do it again! I bet sauna
training is great
for racing in the summer!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Undoubtedly. The thought of a pre-race
contest
is also quite invigorating.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I must say though, I was surprised that
you didn't
use the cold water bath
afterward.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
After going through all that trouble, I
couldn't
just throw that heat away!
Never let yourself cool
down!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: The flame of the heart burns eternal!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I-I see now... But take care not to
collapse from
heat exhaustion.
